caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object situated in the center of a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a cylindrical container mounted on a stand. The container is dark gray, appears metallic, and features a handle attached to its side, with a similar-colored, cylindrical rod or tool partially visible inside the container. The base of the object is composed of a vertical shaft that transitions into three curved legs that extend outward, providing support. The shading gives the appearance of three-dimensionality and the metallic texture of the object. The artist’s signature, “HELEN HOBART,” is located in small, neat letters on the lower left side of the image. There are no other objects or details in the background, and the composition is minimalist and centered.
title: Pennsylvania Fat Lamp
